ghost.misplaced: {type} cannot be used here. Kept as it is, left out of the shader.
ghost.missing: The shared source it points to no longer exists. Kept as it is, left out of the shader.
ghost.unknown: This version does not understand {type}. Kept as it is, left out of the shader.

limit.openWarning: Warning: this graph is over the limit and cannot be compiled now; you can trim it and continue: {limits}
limit.reached: Limit reached; this change was not applied: {limits}
number.ladderHelp: Middle button / Alt+right button: move up and down the list to pick a step, then past its left or right edge to change the value. Release to apply, Esc to cancel. Keyboard: Alt+L, arrow keys, Enter.
open.badGraph:
The graph data is incomplete or malformed, so it was not opened.
{detail}
open.badTarget: This address does not name a valid Grape OP. Open the editor from a Grape OP in TD.
open.buildMismatch: The editor core and TD's bootstrap come from different builds; reload the same build.
open.newerVersion:
This graph was saved by a newer Grape. Update Grape before editing; to keep the newer data safe, nothing is written back.
{detail}
open.noTarget: No Grape OP to edit was given. In TD, press Open Editor on a Grape OP.
open.notGrapeGraph:
This graph is not in the new format (grape-graph). Old graphs will be handled by an importer; the new editor does not open them.
{detail}
open.nothingSent: No edit or apply request was sent.
open.notNewFormat: This Grape OP is not in the new editor's format.
open.reasonCompiler: the frontend compiler cannot handle this graph
open.resetConfirm: TD's graph will be replaced by the default graph, and the content listed above will be deleted. Continue?
open.targetMismatch: TD answered for a different Grape OP than this editor.
open.title: Cannot open the editor
open.unsupported:
This entry supports the common TOP nodes (no Uniforms, subgraphs or Frames yet). Nothing was edited or applied; these will come back in later rounds.
Not supported: {reasons}
save.donePending: TD project saved; new changes are still waiting to be applied.
save.notConfirmed: TD did not confirm that the project was saved; the applied graph is only in TD's memory.
save.pending: Some changes have not been applied yet; resolve the errors first.
sources.declarationProblem: This change to a shared source was not applied ({problem}).
sources.name: Name
sources.nameFormat: {name} is not a valid name: start with a letter, then letters, digits or _ (no __).
sources.nameReserved: {name} is reserved by GLSL or TouchDesigner.
sources.nameTaken: The name {name} is already used by another shared source.
sources.noConstants: No global constants yet. A constant is written into the shader as const and can be used by many nodes.
sources.removed: Shared source deleted with the nodes that used it
sources.title: Shared Sources
sources.valueChanged: Shared source value updated; waiting to apply
status.recoveryHelp: On the computer running TD, check that TD is still open (restore its window if minimized), global cooking is on, and TD is not busy with a long task; on a remote device, check the network. After TD restarts, open the editor again from the Grape OP.
status.unsent: Changes not yet sent to TD
structure.openWarning: Warning: this graph breaks the structure rules; you can fix it and continue: {problems}
structure.outputInSubgraph: a subgraph cannot contain a Color Output
structure.outputMissing: the graph needs one Color Output
structure.outputTooMany: only one Color Output is allowed (now {count})
sync.applied: Applied to TD; the project still needs saving
sync.conflict: The graph in TD seems to have been changed. Choose which version to use.
sync.draftMatchesTd: The draft matches TD's graph; in sync.
sync.glslFailedInTd:
GLSL failed to compile in TD. The graph is saved; TD keeps running the last good Shader.
{log}
sync.hostChanged: TD's build has changed; download your draft and reopen the editor.
sync.offlineBusy: TD is not responding (it may be minimized). Your changes stay in the browser and are sent when TD is back.
sync.offlineUnreachable: Cannot reach TD (it may be stuck or closed, or the network is down). Your changes stay in the browser and are sent once connected.
sync.overwriting: Overwriting TD with the editor's draft…
sync.replyMismatch: TD's reply does not match what was sent.
sync.savedCodegenFailed: Graph saved to TD; code generation failed, so TD still runs the last good Shader
sync.savedKnownFailure: Graph saved to TD; this program failed to compile in TD before, so TD still runs the last good Shader.
sync.sendingGraphOnly: Code generation failed; saving only the graph to TD. TD keeps running the last good Shader…
sync.transportFailed: The connection broke or the reply was incomplete; your local document is kept. {reason}
sync.uncertain: Delivery result unknown; automatic sending stopped while checking the version with TD. {reason}
